div.head: VIII Atr 44.1
div.ab: And uton ænne cynehlaford holdlice healdan; ⁊ freonda gehwilc mid rihtan getriwðan oðerne lufige ⁊ healde mid rihte.
[44, 1] et ad unum regalem dominum fide nos teneamus; amicorumque quisque fide recta alium amet et in rectitudine teneat . . . .
And uton ænne cynehlaford holdlice healdan, ⁊ freonda gehwilc mid rihtan getriwðan oðerne lufige ⁊ healde mid rihte.
And uton ænne cynehlaford holdlice healdan and freonda gehwilc mid rihtan getriwðan oðerne lufige and healde mid rihte.
Und lasst uns getreulich Einen königlichen Herrn festhalten; und jeder der Freunde liebe den andern mit rechter Treue und behandle ihn rechtlich.
And let us loyally hold to one royal lord; and let each of [our] friends love the other with true loyalty and treat him rightly.
And let us loyally support one royal lord, and let each of our friends love the other with true fidelity and treat him justly.
And let us loyally support one royal lord, and let each of our friends love the next with true fidelity and support him rightly.
And let us faithfully support one royal lord, and let each of our friends love each other with true devotion and heed him properly.
